notes: Shipped as data, not code, so thresholds can be retuned without an app release.

THRESHOLDS ARE UNCALIBRATED. The bed_aspect cut points derive from the salon '50% rule' (a bed reads normal at roughly 1.5-2x longer than wide), which appears across nail-education content and in no dermatological literature. The finger_to_palm cut points have no source at all - no published work says where a short finger becomes a long one. Both need calibrating against real hands, judged by working nail techs, before this engine is anything more than a plausible guess.
Every rule carries a provenance flag. 'measured' means the statement is about what the camera saw. 'convention' means it is professional practice. The UI must keep those two voices apart.

durability_notes.highest: Curved edges spread stress evenly, so there is no weak point to break at.
durability_notes.high: Curves rather than corners; holds up well to ordinary use.
durability_notes.medium: Sound in itself, but the corners are where it catches and breaks.
durability_notes.low: The taper concentrates stress at the tip. Expect breaks without reinforcement.
durability_notes.lowest: The point is the weakest part of the nail and takes all the force.

rules.measured_reason: Your nail beds came out at {value:.2f} — wider than they are long.
rules.convention_reason: Nail techs would read that and reach for a taper: curved sides visually narrow a wide bed.

rules.measured_reason: Your nail beds came out at {value:.2f} — notably longer than they are wide.
rules.convention_reason: Straight sides fill out a narrow bed, where a taper would make it look narrower still.

rules.measured_reason: Your nail beds came out at {value:.2f} — well proportioned.
rules.convention_reason: That proportion carries most shapes, so the choice is closer to preference than to fit.

rules.measured_reason: Your fingers measured {value:.2f} against your palm width — on the shorter side.
rules.convention_reason: A tapered tip reads as an extension of the finger, which lengthens the whole hand.

rules.measured_reason: Your fingers measured {value:.2f} against your palm width — on the longer side.
rules.convention_reason: Long fingers carry a blunt, bold shape without looking out of proportion.

rules.measured_reason: Your fingers taper toward the tip.
rules.convention_reason: Following that taper tends to look more natural than cutting against it.

rules.measured_reason: Your nail beds sit short relative to the length of your fingers.
rules.convention_reason: A short bed carries a compact shape better than a long dramatic one.

fallback.reason: Squoval is the shape nail techs reach for when they are not sure — it suits nearly everyone, which is exactly what makes it the honest answer when the measurement is not solid enough to say more.

palettes._note: Which colours suit which undertone is professional convention, not colour science. The measurement is ours; the mapping is the industry's.
